decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 166158, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe pass is required.

These seven columns all carry null_rate 0.0 and together narrow a 166158-row table (carrier distinct_count 16, flight distinct_count 2994, origin distinct_count 3, dest distinct_count 100) to one flight instance per day; tailnum was excluded from the grain because its null_rate 0.009154 disqualifies it as a required key.

dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time carry max values up to 2400.0, which is not a valid HH:MM clock value, so they are kept as INTEGER HHMM codes rather than parsed into TIMESTAMP, unlike time_hour whose samples are genuine ISO-8601 strings.

dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time all show matching null clusters (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981) consistent with cancelled or diverted flights, so nulls are retained rather than imputed or dropped.
tailnum has null_rate 0.009154 (1521 of 166158 rows), too sparse to require, so it is kept nullable VARCHAR.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and describe the capture process, not the flight, so all three are dropped.

purpose: This table holds cleaned 2013 NYC-area flight records (one row per scheduled flight instance) for downstream analytics on departure and arrival performance, delay patterns, and route volumes.
usage: Join on the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier, flight, origin, dest) when combining with other flight-related tables, and treat dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time as HHMM-encoded integers (not true clock times) that may need further parsing by the consumer; filter or account for nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum before aggregating delay metrics.
limitations: Roughly 2.9%-3.3% of rows lack dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981 on a 166158-row table), consistent with cancelled or unrecorded flights, and these nulls were retained rather than resolved; tailnum is missing in 0.9154% of rows; the HHMM-style time columns were not converted to true time types because their value ranges (up to 2400.0) are not valid clock values.
